es.title: Calificar leads entrantes
es.outcome: Sistema simple para identificar los prospectos con más probabilidad de comprar.
es.prompt:
Quiero un sistema simple para calificar leads que me llegan.

Mi negocio: [describir].
Clientes ideales: [perfil].
Volumen de leads: [aproximado por mes].

Dame: 5 preguntas que deben responder al contactarme, criterios para clasificar como Frío/Tibio/Caliente y qué hacer con cada tipo de lead.

en.title: Qualify incoming leads
en.outcome: Simple system to identify prospects with the highest likelihood to buy.
en.prompt:
I want a simple system to qualify leads that come to me.

My business: [describe].
Ideal customers: [profile].
Lead volume: [approximate per month].

Give me: 5 questions they should answer when contacting me, criteria to classify as Cold/Warm/Hot and what to do with each type of lead.
